quest.title: The Misplaced Photo
quest.description: You meet a Fatui Mirror Maiden on Broken Isle who keeps going on about losing a photo. It seems that you won't be able to communicate with her normally... But if you find some way to bring her back to her senses, perhaps you might be able to figure out why she is here.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why are the Fatui here? This Mirror Maiden...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're not up to something again, are they?

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: ...I have to get back... I have to get back... He's still there. But my brothers are gone, and their photo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, who are you? What are you doing over here?

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: The photo of my brothers... I can't go back if I lose it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you! Fatui person over there!

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: No, I can't leave him behind... Mustn't leave him alone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Honestly though, Paimon's still wondering how this Mirror Maiden is here in the first place...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Why don't we find a way to wake her up, {NICKNAME}? Then we can ask her what the Fatui scattered outside are up to?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We can't just leave her in this state...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... That Fatuus might be a bit of a weirdo, but Paimon doesn't think it's a good idea to leave her alone.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But how in the world did she end up like this...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It must've been that machine's fault...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh right, the machine affected everyone on the island... But it has been shut down...

response.speaker: Mirror Maiden
response.text: The photo of myself and my brothers... I can't go back if I can't find it. But he's still there, waiting for me, all alone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon gets it now... Let's find that photo that's so dear to her, {NICKNAME}. Maybe it'll bring her to her senses!

choices.text: We aren't getting through to her...

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: The photo of my brothers... I can't go back if I lose it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Looks like we still can't talk to her...)

talks.objective: Look for the photo that the Mirror Maiden lost
Give the pocket watch with the photo back to the Mirror Maiden

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: This... Ah, this is mine. There's a photo of me and my brothers inside...

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: It's so great to have it back. Where did I lose it? ... Agh! My head... hurts...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We found it beside the hilichurl camp!

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: Thank you, thank you so much...

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: #No, wait! You're the blond {F#young woman}{M#young man} and {F#her}{M#his} flying companion, whom we saw in that internal communique!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's "Paimon" to you! But you know what? We might as well change Paimon's name to "flying companion" if this keeps happening...

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: What have you done to me? My...There's a gap in my memories. You didn't perform some weird experiment on me, did you!?

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: We may be on opposing sides... But there must still be limits to one's conduct, surely!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You guys are the ones doing the strange experiments here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We found the photo for you, you know? Is this how you're gonna pay us back?

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: I see... But since I came to my senses, it means that Researcher Persikov's experiment has failed.

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: You've probably guessed the reason for the failure... Well, but from where we stand, we're still enemies. Bringing that photo back to me... Has anyone told you that you're too nice to your foes?

dialogues.speaker: Mirror Maiden
dialogues.text: The logical thing to do would've been to take the enemy's valuable possessions. For example, you should have snatched my group photo from the pocket watch and used it to wring some intel out of me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you seriously lecturing us now...

response.speaker: Mirror Maiden
response.text: ...Indeed. And that's what they taught us after we joined the Fatui.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! What are you guys up to here, huh? Spill the beans!

response.speaker: Mirror Maiden
response.text: I... We... ugh, we came to this island and... Right! Yes, Zakhar!

response.speaker: Mirror Maiden
response.text: He's still there alone. I need to get to him!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Having seemingly remembered something, the Fatuus, now clear of mind, departs.

choices.text: Good idea. We should try that next time.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! We shouldn't be learning from them!

talks.objective: Check the direction that the Mirror Maiden left in

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Zakhar! Zakhar! Can you hear me?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: What happened here? There was a cave here when we first arrived. And what's with the thorns...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, you can thank your Mirage experiments, or whatever that was.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are similar thorns all over the island, but with the help of a certain method...

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: You mean fire? You're not trying to set the thorns on fire, are you? Someone's still inside!

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: To be fair, I've heard that the two of you are extremely dangerous and that we might be attacked even while en route to work.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: But are you seriously going to burn someone alive? Not even the cruelest Fatui Agent would do that.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course not. Anyway, burning these thorns with fire won't do us any good...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We have a way to clear the thorns without hurting people inside.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Seriously? You can't be that good, can you? I don't believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #What? Bah! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's show her how the pros do it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? You did that on purpose!

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Ah, so you saw right through me. What a pity.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grr, you sneaky Fatuus! We almost fell for your trick!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Correction, *you* almost did.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... So, uh, anyway, here's the deal. We'll save the person in there, but in return, you'll have to give us some intel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's how you wring intel out of the enemy, right? By threatening something precious to them?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Whoa, that's inhumane.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah, that does seem kinda inhumane.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you agreeing with her? Whose side are you on!?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Anyway, you want intel? Here's some intel. Agafya. My name's Agafya. That's all I can tell you for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just a name!?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: If I do tell you something important, you could make a scary face, say something like "you've outlived your usefulness," and then take me out...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Our instructor said that there are many such incidents every year, and so we are not to reveal any sensitive information.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We wouldn't do that! And that's a very weird thing for your instructor to say...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Is it? I think that's pretty normal. Anyway, I'm here, all alone, and you can take me out pretty easily. I can't get away.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm... Honestly, this really doesn't feel like a fair trade. Still, {NICKNAME}, let's clear the thorns away first.

talks.objective: Clear out the thorns around the cave entrance

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, there's something fishy about the Mirror Maiden...

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: ...I have to get back... I have to get back... He's still there. But my brothers are gone, and their photo...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Fatuus...

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: The photo of my brothers... I can't go back if I lose it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you! Fatui person over there!

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: No, I can't leave him behind... Mustn't leave him alone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now, pardon me, but I think we've seen this scene before...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Fatuus we met earlier...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right. When we met Chevka earlier, he was muttering about some "insignia" thing, and he came to his senses after we gave the insignia to him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Fatui are doing experiments here that even affect their own people. Well, Paimon calls this "getting a taste of their own medicine"!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That's right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So... This Mirror Maiden could be a member of Chevka's squad, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should we try to find something and get her to regain her senses?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: The photo of myself and my brothers... I can't go back if I can't find it. But he's still there, waiting for me, all alone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon gets it now... {NICKNAME}, let's find that photo that's so dear to her. Maybe that'll help her recover her wits!

choices.text: We aren't getting through to her...

talks.objective: Go into the cave and speak to Agafya

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Zakhar! Zakhar! Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Agafya... What's going on? I was just sleeping. I feel all better now.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* It's good to see that you're alright.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Hehe... Oh, Agafya, about the four fruits you gave me earlier, I didn't eat them. I was saving them for you.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Seriously, you didn't? I picked them for you... Just eat them if you're hungry.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: But things were much harder on you, weren't they? You took on the mission alone, after all. So even though I was very hungry, I held myself back!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? A lone mission? What for, Paimon wonders...

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Well, Yakov nearly broke the device, so...

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Zakhar! Why are you spilling everything to these outsiders!?

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: #Uh, what? Oh, wait. You're the one on the internal communique. {NICKNAME} and...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Flying companion."

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Yes, this is the "flying companion"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's "Paimon"! How hard is it to remember one name?

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Hehe, I can be kind of scatter-brained like that. The name's Zakhar. Wait, you and us... We're enemies!

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Agafya, did you bring them here?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Yes, they rescued you from the thorns. They are nice... enemy rescuers.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: That's right. Soon after you left, huge thorns suddenly sprouted and sealed the cave. Wait, you were the ones who got rid of those giant thorns? Amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You bet we did!

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: But aren't we your enemies? Why help us?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's a good question...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But well, she did promise that if we got you out, she'd tell us exactly what you're plotting here.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: What? You sold us out, Agafya?

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: It's alright, Zakhar. We'll just palm them off with something like "we Fatui are hunting mysterious Medaka in these waters"... or whatnot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Are you seriously talking openly about deceiving us? You're really underestimating us, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, the thorns have been cleared out, and Zakhar is safe and sound. It's time to pay up.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Don't tell them anything, Agafya!

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: *sigh* At this point... To be honest, though, we really don't know much. We were just here to conduct some tests.

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Some sort of signal tests I guess... I don't know the details, but the other group from our squad should know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's all you got?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: That's all I know for sure... Now then, you have our intel, so can you let us go now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We didn't promise that, but you don't seem like you want to cause any trouble...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Consider this a mercy then.

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Well, you have our thanks. Don't know what happened to <color=#00E1FFFF>the guys in the other group</color>, though. We planned to get back to the camp in the middle of the ocean once our mission was completed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The guys in the other group?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Yes, the other group of two. They said they were heading to <color=#00E1FFFF>the two islands in the south</color>. And that's some extra intel for you, free of charge. You didn't trick us into that, you hear?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A large island to the south... That has to be Minacious Isle.

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Alright, let's cut the chatter. We need to hurry back to our base camp...

talks.objective: Look for traces of the other group's members

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, we picked up a pocket watch with a group photo inside it on the island. Could the photo be the one?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Show her the pocket watch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hurry, show her the photo inside the pocket watch!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Show her the pocket watch.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Ah, Zakhar... I hope you're safe and sound... What is it? You haven't cleared the thorns yet?

choices.text: What exactly are you up to here?

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: We're just running errands here. That's all I can tell you.

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Zakhar is my teammate. He's not feeling well...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: I wonder if something happened to him...

choices.text: About the photo inside the pocket watch...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: That has nothing to do with the Fatui, and there's nothing there that you'd find interesting, either. I'm grateful that you helped me find the pocket watch, but I can't tell you about it...

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: Zakhar! Zakhar! Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: Agafya... What's going on? I was just sleeping. I feel all better now.

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* It's good to see that you're alright.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They did tell us a whole bunch of stuff, yeah. But is this all you got?

response.speaker: Agafya

response.speaker: Paimon

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Well, you have our thanks. I don't know what happened to the guys in the other group. We planned to get back to the camp in the center of the sea once we'd completed our mission.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Other group"? Oh, wait, you're talking about...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: She's talking about the Fatui we met earlier...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: You've met them? Zakhar, we have to return to camp and reach the rendezvous point as soon as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Agafya
dialogues.text: What is it? Is there anything else? I've already told you everything I know...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Like I told you, I don't know much about it... They were probably just some simple tests, but running all over these islands was just... incredibly tiring.

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Zakhar is an orphan. His parents died of illness long ago, and it is said that he led a difficult life for a long time. He then heard that the Fatui provided free meals, and decided to join them...

response.speaker: Agafya
response.text: Well, that's my two brothers in the photo, both of whom have devoted their services to Snezhnaya. I've always been proud of them.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: We are enemies, you know? We really shouldn't be chatting this much.

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: If you talk to the enemy too much, you will become close and your heart softens, which puts you at a disadvantage in battle...

dialogues.speaker: Zakhar
dialogues.text: That's what our instructor told us.
